    SUM(CASE
        WHEN lp."status" IN ('A', 'C') THEN GREATEST(lp."loan_amount" - lp."actual_payments", 0)
        ELSE 0
    END) AS total_debt,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lp."status" IN ('B', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Problematic (overdue or default)'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lp."status" = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND
             SUM(CASE WHEN lp."status" = 'A' THEN lp."actual_payments" ELSE 0 END) >=
             SUM(CASE WHEN lp."status" = 'A' THEN lp."expected_payments" ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Good (payments on track)'

        ELSE 'No active loans'
    END AS payment_status
FROM
    loan_payments lp;
